title: Sage chat — grounding family
notes: Promotes the existing `grounding` family of scripts/sage-chat-harness.mjs (3 cases today) to a gated numeric metric. Spawned unmodified via `--families=grounding --provider=gemini`; reads the harness's own byFamily.grounding bucket. Floor 1.0 per the design table (§4.2): grounding failures mean a fabricated or unsupported claim, which this repo treats as zero-tolerance. Expanding to the 30-golden-Q&A corpus the design calls for is future work, not part of this promotion.
